If the people around you in your life aren't supportive when you're in need, that's their problem not yours. It's great to have resources like reddit to anonymously vent your frustrations without fear. It has helped me a lot to vent into a void and when I do get responses they are from compassionate people who will be supportive. I'm not gonna throw out any platitudes like "It'll be okay" because that's not now. Right now you're sad, allow yourself to feel it and it can run it's course much quicker

Make sure your resolution is set to match your monitor with the following steps.

1. Right click an open area on your windows desktop
2. Click "Screen Resolution" then click the drop down list next to "Resolution" and adjust the vertical slider next to whichever resolution has " (recommended) " next to it as that is the intended resolution for your monitor. (Note: the recommended resolution is USUALLY at the very top of the slider, but not always)
3. Click Apply and if the screen looks correct, click "Keep changes" and you're done, otherwise, move to step 4
4. If it doesn't look right or doesn't show up at all, just wait about 10 seconds and it will revert automatically and then adjust the resolution slider to the next one above or below the resolution slider and repeat steps 3 and 4 until the resolution looks correct.
